events.title: First Representative Legislative Assembly in the Americas Convenes
events.description: The Virginia House of Burgesses held its first meeting at the church in Jamestown, Virginia, bringing together elected representatives from the English colony's settlements.
events.significance: It was the first elected legislative body in English North America and laid early groundwork for representative self-government in what became the United States.

events.title: Birth of Henry Ford
events.description: Henry Ford, the American industrialist and founder of the Ford Motor Company, was born on a farm in Greenfield Township, Michigan.
events.significance: Ford's introduction of the moving assembly line and the affordable Model T transformed manufacturing and made automobiles accessible to the middle class, reshaping modern industry and society.

events.title: USS Indianapolis Sunk
events.description: After delivering components of the atomic bomb to Tinian, the heavy cruiser USS Indianapolis was torpedoed by Japanese submarine I-58 and sank in the Philippine Sea. Of about 1,195 crew, roughly 900 survived the sinking, but many died from exposure, dehydration, and shark attacks before rescue days later.
events.significance: It was the worst single loss of life at sea in U.S. Navy history and led to a controversial court-martial of Captain Charles McVay III, who was later exonerated.

events.title: Medicare and Medicaid Signed into Law
events.description: President Lyndon B. Johnson signed the Social Security Amendments of 1965 at the Harry S. Truman Library in Independence, Missouri, creating Medicare and Medicaid.
events.significance: These programs expanded health coverage for older Americans and low-income people, and remain cornerstones of the U.S. healthcare system.

events.title: Disappearance of Jimmy Hoffa
events.description: Former Teamsters union president Jimmy Hoffa vanished after leaving a restaurant in Bloomfield Township, Michigan, where he was reportedly to meet with organized crime figures.
events.significance: Hoffa was declared legally dead in 1982, and the unsolved case became one of the most famous mysteries in American history and popular culture.
